entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
The Day of Judgement came near, and the moon has split (with the indication of the Beloved Prophet Muhammad).
And if they (i.e. the disbelievers) see a sign, they therefore turn away their faces and say, 'This is just ongoing magic.'
And they belied (the Beloved Prophet Muhammad) and followed their own desires, and each matter has been decided.
And indeed, those tidings have come to them wherein there was enough deterrence.
(The Qur'aan is) perfect wisdom, then what benefit do warners give (to those who are destined to disbelieve)?
So, turn your face away from them; the Day when the caller (i.e. the angel Israafeel) will call towards a severe unknown matter (i.e. the horror of the Day of Judgement).
They will come out from the graves with eyes downcast, as if they are scattered swarms of locusts.
Hastening towards the caller; the disbelievers will say, 'This is a hard day.'
Before these (i.e. the disbelievers), the people of Nooh belied, thus they belied Our bondsman and said, 'He is a mad man,' and scolded him.
So, he supplicated to his Lord; that 'I am overpowered, therefore take revenge on my behalf.'
We henceforth opened the gates of heaven, with water flowing intensely.
And made the earth as springs gushing out, so the two waters met; totalling a quantity which was destined.
And We caused Nooh to board upon the structure (i.e. Ark) of wooden planks and nails.
Sailing in front of Our sight; (all of this happened) as a reward for him (i.e. for Nooh) who was rejected (by the people).
And We left this (incident) as a sign; so, is there anyone to ponder?
So, how (dreadful) was My punishment and My threats?
And We have indeed made the Qur'aan easy to memorise; so, is there anyone to memorise (i.e. learn the Qur'aan by heart)?
(The tribe of) 'Aad belied; so, how was My punishment and the declarations of My warnings?
We indeed sent towards them a severe windstorm, on a day whose ill-fortune lasted upon them forever.
It was demolishing people in such a way as if they were uprooted trunks of date trees.
So, how was My punishment and the declarations of My warnings?
And We have indeed made the Qur'aan easy to memorise; so, is there anyone to memorise (it)?
The (tribe of) Thamood belied the Messengers.
So, they said, 'Shall we follow a man from amongst us? Then (if we do so), we are definitely misguided and foolish.'
(The Thamood said), 'From all of us, has the revelation come down (only) upon him? Rather, he (i.e. the Prophet Saalih) is most untruthful, boastful.'
(Allah replied) 'They will soon come to know who was the most untruthful, boastful.'
'We are about to send the she-camel to test them; therefore, O Saalih, wait and have patience.'
'And inform them that the water is to be shared between (the she-camel and) them. Only those whose turn it is may come to their share (to obtain the water).'
Consequently, they called their companion (i.e. Qadaar Bin Saalif) who therefore caught (the she-camel) and cut the arteries from the lower part of her legs.
So, how was My punishment and the declarations of My warnings?
Indeed, We sent upon them a single Scream, thereupon they became like leftover twigs of dry trampled grass of the builder of a cattle enclosure.
And We have indeed made the Qur'aan easy to memorise; so, is there anyone to memorise (it)?
The people of Loot belied the Messengers.
Indeed, We sent a storm of stones upon them except the family of Loot; We rescued them in the last part of the night.
As a favour from Us; this is how We reward the one who is thankful.
And indeed, he had warned them about Our grip; consequently, they doubted in the declarations of warning.
And they tried to influence him regarding his guests (for an ill purpose); We henceforth blinded their eyes. (Allah said) 'Taste My punishment and the declarations of warning.'
And indeed, the lasting punishment came upon them early in the morning.
'So, taste My punishment, and declarations of warning.'
And We have indeed made the Qur'aan easy to memorise; so, is there anyone to memorise (it)?
And indeed, the Messengers came to the people of Fir'awn.
They belied all of Our signs, We henceforth seized them (with punishment) as was befitting to the Magnificence of the Most Honourable, the All-Powerful.
(O people of Arabia) are your disbelievers better than them (the previous disbelievers), or is your exemption written in the Books?
Or do they say, 'We shall all take revenge together as a group.'?
The group will soon be chased away, and they will turn their backs (to flee).
Rather, the Day of Judgement is their promised time, and the Day of Judgement is very dreadful and very bitter.
Indeed, the criminals are misguided and are insane.
On the Day when they will be dragged upon their faces in the Fire, and it will be said to them, 'Taste the heat of Hell.'
We have indeed created everything with a proper measure.
And Our command is only saying once, like the blink of an eye.
And We have indeed destroyed (many groups) like you; so, is there anyone to ponder?
And whatever they did is present in the Books.
And every small and great thing is documented.
Indeed, the pious are amongst Gardens and streams.
Present in an assembly of the truth, in the Majestic Court of the Most Powerful King.
